author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Optional Brotli compression failures escape the hook.
findings.consequence: If zlib reports an error, Nitro catches the rejected beforeResponse hook and records a request/response error even though the original identity response can still be sent. That turns an optional optimization failure into operational error noise.
findings.evidence: Line 65 awaits compressHtml without a local catch. The unit test at test/unit/response-compression.spec.ts:175-183 confirms the hook rejects on compression failure while leaving the identity body and headers intact. Nitro's beforeResponse wrapper in node_modules/nitropack/dist/runtime/internal/app.mjs:82-84 catches rejected beforeResponse hooks via captureError.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the compression await in a try/catch inside the hook; on failure, leave response.body and content-length unchanged after Vary has been set, and return without rethrowing.
